en.headline: Seven-year-old boy in critical condition with severe influenza A
en.dek: The Centre for Health Protection is investigating a severe paediatric influenza A case involving a previously healthy boy who developed shock and encephalopathy.
body: The Centre for Health Protection is investigating a severe paediatric influenza A infection involving a seven-year-old boy who remains in critical condition.

The boy, who had good past health, developed a cough and runny nose on 27 July and a fever on 1 August. His condition deteriorated on Monday with decreased responsiveness. He was taken to Princess Margaret Hospital’s accident and emergency department and admitted to the paediatric intensive care unit. His respiratory specimen tested positive for influenza A (H3). The clinical diagnosis was influenza A infection complicated by shock and encephalopathy.

The boy had received the 2025/26 seasonal influenza vaccination and had no travel history during the incubation period. One household contact recently had mild upper respiratory symptoms that tested positive for influenza on a rapid antigen test and has since recovered. Hong Kong entered the influenza season in late June; the latest data showed 10.65 per cent of respiratory specimens testing positive for seasonal influenza viruses last week, with activity expected to remain high.

zh.headline: 七歲男童感染甲型流感危殆 併發休克及腦病變
zh.dek: 衞生防護中心正調查一宗嚴重兒童甲型流感個案，一名過往健康良好的七歲男童出現休克及腦病變，情況危殆。
body: 衞生防護中心正調查一宗嚴重兒童甲型流感感染個案，七歲男童情況危殆。
男童過往健康良好，7月27日出現咳嗽及流鼻水，8月1日發燒。周一情況惡化，反應減弱，被送往瑪嘉烈醫院急症室，其後入住兒童深切治療部。其呼吸道樣本對甲型流感（H3）呈陽性，臨床診斷為甲型流感感染併發休克及腦病變。
男童已接種2025/26年度季節性流感疫苗，潛伏期內無外遊。一名同住家人近日出現輕微上呼吸道症狀，快速抗原測試對流感呈陽性，其後已康復。香港於6月底進入流感季節，最新監測顯示上周呼吸道樣本季節性流感陽性比率為10.65%，預期未來數周流感活躍程度仍會維持高企。
